{{Quote|Rebels on Hoth? All I have is your word for it? What could they be doing on such a worthless planet? I'm deleting your reports.|General Nevar|<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Dark Side scenario">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
'''Nevar''' was an incompetent [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Brigadier General/Legends|brigadier general]] whose career in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was defined by nepotism and sycophancy. Circa early [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Nevar supervised a failed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] expedition to capture and conscript the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kyrisa]], who had taken refuge on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the unsuccessful operation, the Imperial expedition encountered a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] group setting up an outpost on Hoth, although when word of the Rebel presence reached Nevar, he incredulously deleted the report out of hand. Nevar's lack of insight allowed what was in actuality the Rebellion's [[Alliance High Command/Legends|headquarters]] of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] to remain hidden from the Empire for more than a [[Standard year/Legends|year]].

Following Echo Base's eventual discovery by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Nevar commanded the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Blizzard 2/Legends|Blizzard 2]] of [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]], under the overall direction of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], during the subsequent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. During the battle, Nevar's Blizzard 2 earned the dubious distinction of being the first Imperial [[Walker/Legends|walker]] downed by defending Rebel forces. At some point during the Battle of Hoth, the treacherous Nevar was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]].

==Biography==
===An error in judgment===
{{Quote|This ridiculous adventure was a mistake from the beginning!|General Nevar|<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Dark Side scenario" />}}
[[Brigadier General/Legends|Brigadier General]] Nevar was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWCL" /> His<ref name="Blizzard 2" /> career was a triumph of nepotism and sycophantic behavior.<ref name="TSS" /> Circa early [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date2">''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]'' Dark Side Campaign scenario of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' takes place "over a [[Standard year/Legends|year]]" prior to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] discovery of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. This places ''The Nightsister's Revenge'' in circa early [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> Nevar found himself overseeing an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] mission to the remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in search of the rogue [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kyrisa]], who possessed the [[Force power/Legends|Force ability]] to exert control over wild creatures. [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Imperial Intelligence Director]] [[Cronal|"Blackhole"]] hoped to capture Kyrisa to take advantage of her powers for the purposes of beast mastery and [[Spy/Legends|espionage]].<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Dark Side scenario" />

The Imperial expedition to Hoth, led by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agent [[Jeffren Brek]], ultimately failed to capture Kyrisa.<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Dark Side scenario" /> Moreover, in the midst of the search for Kyrisa, elements of the Imperial expedition team encountered and [[Battle of Hoth (2 ABY)|battled]] a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] outfit, which was attempting to establish an outpost on Hoth's inhospitable surface. The Rebels annihilated the small Imperial force,<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Light Side scenario">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref> and Brek's team failed to obtain any real evidence of the Rebels' presence on Hoth. However, when Brek filed his report with Nevar at the conclusion of the operation from aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], Nevar dismissed Brek's claims of the Rebel presence as foolishness and deleted his reports, disbelieving the Rebellion would even be on such a worthless planet.<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Dark Side scenario" />

What Nevar did not realize was that Brek had actually stumbled across the earliest traces of<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Dark Side scenario" /> [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Nevar's error in judgment helped keep the Rebel base's existence a secret from the Empire for over a [[Standard year/Legends|year]]<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Dark Side scenario" /> until its eventual discovery by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="SWCL" />

===Battle of Hoth===
[[File:Blizzard_2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Blizzard 2, the AT-AT walker commanded by General Nevar during the Battle of Hoth]]
Ironically enough, Nevar was later part of the sizable Imperial force under the command of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader sent to destroy Echo Base<ref name="SWCL" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> Nevar served under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] during the Imperial invasion of Echo Base as part of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. He commanded the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Blizzard 2/Legends|Blizzard 2]] of [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]], the elite ground assault unit attached to [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], Vader's personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="SWCL" />

Nevar's AT-AT was eventually brought down by a Rebel [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]], using the [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder's]] [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon and tow cable]] to trip the [[Walker/Legends|walker's]] legs. After Blizzard 2 fell,<ref name="SWCL" /> Antilles and another Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] destroyed the downed walker by targeting its vulnerable neck area.<ref name="ESB junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> Nevar's Blizzard 2 was the first Imperial walker dispatched during the battle.<ref name="SWCL" /> At some point surrounding the tripping of Blizzard 2, the treacherous Nevar was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]].<ref name="Blizzard 2" />

==Personality and traits==
Nevar was incompetent<ref name="TSS" /> and immoral,<ref name="CSWE-Blizzard Force">{{CSWECite|I|79|Blizzard Force}}</ref> and his [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] career was characterized by his own sycophantic behavior.<ref name="TSS" /> His failure to properly assess the reports of the Rebel presence on Hoth would keep the Empire searching for the hidden Rebel base for more than a year<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Dark Side scenario" /> until Echo Base was discovered just prior to the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.<ref name="Date" /> Out of paranoia, Nevar fortified the exterior of Blizzard 2 with an extra layer of [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Nevar was also treacherous, and he was assassinated during the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="Blizzard 2" /><ref name="SWCL" />

Nevar, a [[Human/Legends|Human]], had dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]], dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="TSS" />

==Equipment==
Brigadier General Nevar wore the standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]]. On at least one occasion, he opted not to don the [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform's]] [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Officer's gloves|gloves]].<ref name="TSS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The General Nevar character was first mentioned on the "Blizzard 2" card from the [[November]] [[1996]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], which explains that the "treacherous" Nevar commanded the Blizzard 2 AT-AT prior to his assassination. However, the card does not elaborate under what circumstances Nevar's treachery or assassination take place.<ref name="Blizzard 2" /> The first illustration of Nevar was included in the [[September]] [[2009]] ''[[The Shadow Syndicate]]'' expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'',<ref name="TSS" /> and the character was briefly featured in the game's ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]'' adventure scenario.<ref name="Nightsister's Revenge Dark Side scenario" />

Nevar was also mentioned in the [[August]] [[2004]] ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' and the subsequent [[October]] [[2005]] compilation book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] among the texts' "Battle of Hoth" geographic layout. ''Inside the Worlds'' identifies Nevar as holding the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of brigadier general, different from the original ''SW''CCG reference and even the later ''SWGTCG'' reference, both of which identify him only as a general. Additionally, ''Inside the Worlds'' explains that "Wedge&hellip;[deploys] [[Rogue Three/Legends|Rogue 3's]] harpoon and tow cable against the AT-AT commanded by Brigadier General Nevar," suggesting that Nevar is still in command of the AT-AT at that [[Time/Legends|time]] and thus was assassinated during the battle itself, sometime during or after Antilles' attack on Blizzard 2.<ref name="SWCL" /><ref name="IWST">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>
